verdict.rationale: Lovable's project docs say the in-project Code view shows your app's source code, which you can browse, edit, and download. That directly matches opening and editing generated code inside the builder, and the welcome docs add that apps are 'backed by editable code'. The support rests on a single short line: the docs don't describe the editor's features (file tree, saving, syntax support) or any plan limits, and no hands-on or community report confirms in-builder editing. Local IDE editing via Git sync is a separate workaround and gets no credit here. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the in-builder code editor's capabilities and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of direct in-builder editing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open and edit the generated source code directly inside the builder

citations.quote: Code: Your app's source code, which you can browse, edit, and download.
